findings.report:
## 1. Capture browser-local usefulness feedback on mining proposals (pending Remi review)

Browser-local useful / not-useful capture on mining proposals to give Remi a lightweight usefulness signal without implementation or publication.

**Why now:** Goal defines a useful proposal but usefulness judgment is still pending owner review; operational gates passed do not establish proposal quality (work-in-progress.md:7, goal.md:15).

**Evidence**
- factory/context/work-in-progress.md:19-22 lists 'Capture browser-local usefulness feedback' as existing candidate awaiting Remi review, not accepted work
- docs/verification.md:19,27 focused baseline wrun_01M2AQ0E5CN1HVCD71RC6TPGD5 proposed usefulness-feedback capture; owner usefulness judgment remains pending
- apps/factory/app/components/MiningRun.vue:88-101 proposal cards render outcome/whyNow/evidence with 'Use this proposal' but no usefulness judgment control
- apps/factory/app/app.vue:24-30,56-73 drafts remain browser-local via adeo-factory-drafts-v1; API does not claim shared persistence
- GitHub issues complete 2026-09-12T12:30:29Z: 1 open item PR #1 cockpit APIs; no issue tracks feedback capture
- Vercel cockpit production dpl_2PuzWWXcCHrePBy9R3ovrdXFgoWB READY at 3b6b8fad matches snapshot revision

**Existing work:** Pending candidate from native baseline and hosted review (docs/verification.md:10,58); not implemented. PR #1 covers cockpit APIs/drafts but adds no feedback control. Do not reintroduce as newly discovered.

**Scope**
- Add per-proposal judgment control in MiningRun proposal card only
- Store locally alongside drafts; no backend, no auto-publish, no factory-rule change
- Document in verification.md as proposal, not owner acceptance

**Acceptance criteria**
- Remi can mark a proposal useful / not-useful with optional reason without publishing anything
- Signal stays browser-local by design like drafts; no shared persistence claimed
- Reviewed reflection notes whether the signal would transfer to a shared eval

**Uncertainties**
- Remi taste: whether binary signal plus reason is enough to judge usefulness
- Whether browser-local signal transfers to shared eval or stays personal
- Hosted handoff still unverified, so placement may need adjustment after live observation

## Reflection

**helpfulContext**
- goal.md factory-first test: Jira work justified only when it tests/teaches factory now
- work-in-progress.md pending-status correction prevents treating empty GitHub list as greenfield
- verification.md dated native/hosted history distinguishes operational gates from owner acceptance
- MiningRun.vue + app.vue show proposal-to-draft is browser-local by design

**missingContext**
- No GitHub issue/PR or comment thread tracks either candidate; PR #1 is unrelated cockpit APIs — absence is informational, not evidence of no work per work-in-progress.md
- Per-deployment build logs not sampled (build_logs requires deploymentId); deployments list confirms READY revisions
- Held-out evals and Git history excluded from snapshot by design; not inspected

**contradictions**
None recorded.

**suggestedImprovements**
- Ask Remi whether binary useful/not-useful plus optional reason suffices, or a different question would test transfer
- Ask Remi which workshop demo slice would settle scope: issue/board read-only vs accounts/permissions vs API parity subset

## Context gaps

- Choose a deployment ID from this project's deployment evidence before reading logs.
- Hosted native report-to-draft handoff and Vercel runtime-log sample for production deployments dpl_2PuzWWXcCHrePBy9R3ovrdXFgoWB (cockpit) / dpl_A5oFTnQ7QVrEanjQYKraG7Fs9H17 (jira) not inspected in this run; needed to confirm where usefulness feedback would be seen and that deployed behavior matches snapshot before sizing implementation.
